title: amaryllis littoralis
intro: Amaryllis littoralis, commonly known as the lilyturf or blue lilyturf, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the family Asphodelaceae. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing, due to its therapeutic actions such as antibacterial and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents present in Amaryllis littoralis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is required to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
